title: The best demo includes the part that broke.
summary: A practical recipe for sharing an AI experiment that someone else can actually learn from.

body.heading: Give people a starting point
body.text: State the problem in one sentence. Include the tool or repository, version, setup, and a small public input. Explain what a successful result would look like before you show the output.

body.heading: Report what happened
body.text: Separate observed results from your hopes. Include a failure case and describe any human corrections. If you report speed or accuracy, describe the measurement and environment so another person can try it.

body.heading: End with an invitation
body.text: Offer a small next experiment. Invite a specific improvement, such as a clearer setup guide or a second test case. A useful contribution can be a paragraph, not just a polished application.
